findings.evidence: routing.py:19,22: dispatch and dispatch_batch call legacy_route instead of route_request.
findings.summary: Production dispatch still routes through legacy_route.

findings.evidence: routing.py:13-17: legacy_route defines its own routes table and lookup; it never calls route_request.
findings.summary: legacy_route duplicates routing logic instead of delegating to the sole implementation.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:13: attested_digest != artifact_digest uses ordinary string comparison.
findings.summary: Digest equality does not use hmac.compare_digest.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:15-17: allowed_roots and change["path"] are used without checks for empty, absolute, or non-normalized paths; a root of "" matches every path.
findings.summary: Paths and roots are accepted without validation.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:17: with allowed_roots=["src"], a change at "src2/file" passes startswith("src").
findings.summary: Root containment uses a raw string prefix.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:17: only change["path"] is examined, so a rename with an out-of-scope source and in-scope destination can pass.
release_policy.py:16-17: a record with an in-scope path passes regardless of missing fields or an unknown action.
findings.summary: Malformed records and unknown actions can pass.
